thought.text: The packages installed successfully but the extension directory isn't where expected. Let me check where PostGIS placed its files (which should be in the same location).

reasoning_content: The pgrouting package installed successfully, but the extension directory doesn't exist at the expected path. I'm checking where PostgreSQL 17 actually places its extension files—it could be under the postgresql-17 package directory structure or elsewhere in the system. The PostGIS image likely places extension files in a cluster-specific directory rather than the standard global path, which would explain why I'm not finding them where I expected. I should check the actual PostGIS extension path to see where those files ended up.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "docker run --rm -v /tmp/pgrouting-debs:/debs postgis/postgis:17-3.5 sh -c '
cp /debs/pgrouting.deb /tmp/pgr.deb
cp /debs/pgrouting-scripts.deb /tmp/pgrs.deb
dpkg -i /tmp/pgrs.deb /tmp/pgr.deb >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "=== dpkg files for pgrouting ==="
dpkg -L postgresql-17-pgrouting | grep -E "extension|\.control|\.sql" 
echo "=== dpkg files for pgrouting-scripts ==="
dpkg -L postgresql-17-pgrouting-scripts | grep -E "extension|\.control|\.sql"
echo "=== where is postgis extension ==="
dpkg -L postgresql-17-postgis-3 | grep -E "extension/postgis.control|postgis--3" | head
'", "description": "Locate pgrouting and postgis extension files after install", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Locate pgrouting and postgis extension files"}
